narration: Still the ceiling above it is bare. Bare as a plate.
caption: उसके ऊपर छत अब भी ख़ाली है। थाली जैसी ख़ाली।
image_brief: The upper wall bright with crocodile shadow while the flat ceiling above stays empty, the light stopping at the corner join.

narration: Ishaan drags the stool nearer the cot. The circle slides up.
caption: इशान स्टूल को खाट के पास खींचता है। रोशनी का गोला ऊपर सरक जाता है।
image_brief: Ishaan dragging the wooden stool across the floorboards with the torch wobbling on top, the light circle sliding upward.

narration: He tries holding the torch under his chin. It slips out.
caption: वह टॉर्च को ठुड्डी के नीचे दबाने की कोशिश करता है। वह फिसल जाती है।
image_brief: Ishaan tucking the torch under his chin with both hands raised, the beam pointing crookedly down at the floorboards.

narration: One hand on the torch leaves one hand free. One hand makes a duck.
caption: एक हाथ टॉर्च पर, तो सिर्फ़ एक हाथ बचता है। एक हाथ से बत्तख़ बनती है।
image_brief: Ishaan gripping the torch in one fist and making a one-handed duck shadow with the other hand on the wall.

narration: A crocodile needs two hands. Someone must hold the torch.
caption: मगरमच्छ के लिए दो हाथ चाहिए। टॉर्च कोई और पकड़े।
image_brief: Both of Ishaan's empty hands held open in the beam, the torch standing alone on the stool between his wrists.

narration: So Ishaan asks his sister to hold it. She sits up.
caption: तो इशान बहन से टॉर्च पकड़ने को कहता है। वह उठ बैठती है।
image_brief: Ishaan passing the torch to his little sister across the gap between the two cots, light swinging between their faces.

narration: She takes it and turns it on her own hands.
caption: वह टॉर्च लेकर उसे अपने ही हाथों की तरफ़ घुमा देती है।
image_brief: The sister holding the torch turned toward her own raised fingers, a rabbit shadow appearing on her side of the room.

narration: His sister wants the ceiling too. For a rabbit.
caption: बहन को भी छत चाहिए। अपने खरगोश के लिए।
image_brief: The sister kneeling on her cot pointing the torch upward, a thin stretched rabbit shadow wobbling above her head.

narration: Now two children want one small torch. Nobody lets go.
caption: अब दो बच्चे एक छोटी टॉर्च चाहते हैं। कोई नहीं छोड़ता।
image_brief: Both children's hands gripping the same torch in the middle of the dark bedroom, the beam pinched between their fingers.

narration: Ishaan pulls. His sister pulls harder.
caption: इशान खींचता है। बहन उससे ज़्यादा ज़ोर से खींचती है।
image_brief: A tug of war over the torch between Ishaan and his sister, her blanket sliding off the cot, light streaking over the ceiling.

narration: The torch drops onto the floorboards. It rolls.
caption: टॉर्च फ़र्श के तख़्तों पर गिर जाती है। वह लुढ़कती है।
image_brief: The torch fallen on bare floorboards, still lit, rolling past a pair of slippers, its beam sweeping the room.

narration: The ring at its front twists loose. The glass slides sideways.
caption: उसके आगे का छल्ला ढीला हो जाता है। काँच बगल में सरक जाता है।
image_brief: The fallen torch on the floor with its front ring unscrewed and the round glass disc tilted out of place.

narration: The wide yellow circle is gone. Now the light comes out in a stripe.
caption: चौड़ा पीला गोला ग़ायब है। अब रोशनी पट्टी बनकर निकलती है।
image_brief: A narrow bar of torchlight lying across the floorboards, the walls and ceiling of the bedroom in darkness.

narration: Three fingers wide. The circle had covered half the wall.
caption: तीन उँगली चौड़ी। पहले गोला आधी दीवार ढक लेता था।
image_brief: Ishaan holding three fingers against the thin stripe of light on the floor to measure how wide it is.

narration: Ishaan's whole crocodile will not fit in a stripe. Only its nose.
caption: इशान का पूरा मगरमच्छ पट्टी में नहीं समाता। सिर्फ़ उसकी नाक।
image_brief: Ishaan's joined hands inside the narrow band of light with only a small crocodile nose showing as shadow on the wall.
